name: Dianomi plc
summary: Dianomi Plc is a digital advertising firm that specializes in driving contextual lead generation for prominent clients across the financial, technology, and corporate sectors. The company provides a range of advertising solutions, including cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-lead (CPL) models, further bolstered by its transparent publisher network, advanced contextual smart technology, and detailed reporting capabilities. They also offer expert consultative services. A standout feature is Dianomi's Level2Insight platform, engineered to refine campaign performance through competitor benchmarking, multivariate testing, precise demographic targeting, and customized surveys. Beyond these, their portfolio extends to paid search management, cost-per-acquisition (CPA) networks, and broader online lead generation initiatives. To ensure optimal strategic outcomes, Dianomi also furnishes clients with a comprehensive marketing intelligence platform. This powerful tool is designed to maximize overall marketing plan ROI, from enhancing click-through rates to securing successful client acquisitions. Established in 2002, the company maintains its headquarters in London, United Kingdom, with additional key operational hubs located in New York, USA, and Pyrmont, Australia.
